explanation.baixo: Low-risk result: few or no signs of autism. Keep monitoring the child's development and keep up routine pediatric visits.
explanation.medio: Medium-risk result: the Follow-Up Interview (M-CHAT-R/F) is recommended to look more closely at the items not passed. If the risk is confirmed, seek a specialized evaluation.
explanation.alto: High-risk result: a specialized diagnostic evaluation is needed as soon as possible. Book an appointment with a professional trained in child development (neuropediatrician, child psychiatrist or multidisciplinary team).

highRisk.title: Next step: specialized evaluation
highRisk.body: By protocol, the Follow-Up Interview is not indicated at this risk level. Refer the child now for a diagnostic evaluation and early intervention, without waiting for further screening. Bring this report to the appointment.

instructions.title: INSTRUCTIONS
instructions.intro: The following pages contain statements describing how children may act. Read each statement and select the option that best describes how often your child shows these behaviors.
instructions.introBold: Select one option for each statement.
instructions.guidelines: Use these guidelines to mark your answers:
instructions.whenOpportunity: When given the opportunity, my child...
instructions.yesNo: Answer each question with Yes or No, thinking about the child's usual behavior. If the behavior happened only once or twice and is not usual, answer as if it did not happen. Select one option for each question.
instructions.followup: For each item not passed in the screening, read the original question and probe the caregiver following the script. Then mark Passed or Failed according to the rule given in the script.

almostAlways.label: Almost always
almostAlways.description: responds this way Almost always (90% of the time or more).

frequently.label: Frequently
frequently.description: responds this way Frequently (75% of the time).

halfTheTime.label: Half the time
halfTheTime.description: responds this way Half the time (50% of the time).

occasionally.label: Occasionally
occasionally.description: responds this way Occasionally (25% of the time).

almostNever.label: Almost never
almostNever.description: responds this way Almost never (10% of the time or less).

notApplicable.label: Not applicable
notApplicable.description: If you cannot answer because you have not observed the behavior or think the item does not apply to your child, select Not applicable.

quadrants.title: Sensory Processing Quadrants
quadrants.intro: The four quadrants describe patterns in how the child processes sensory stimuli in daily life.

seeking.title: Sensory Seeking
seeking.description: Actively seeks more sensory experiences than is typical for the age.

avoiding.title: Sensory Avoiding
avoiding.description: Tries to reduce contact with sensory stimuli they find unpleasant.

sensitivity.title: Sensory Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Notices and reacts more strongly to stimuli that other children barely perceive.

registration.title: Sensory Registration
registration.description: Tends not to notice stimuli that other children notice; reduced sensory registration.

scores.title: Score Summary
scores.normed: Scores are classified by comparing the child's performance with other children of the same age range.
scores.banded: Scores show the frequency observed per section, according to the bands defined by this instrument.
